propositions: Five test modules repeatedly construct equivalent virgin git/rebar store topologies for every test consumer despite identical preconditions, causing setup spans to dominate wall time; measurements show real store construction is 12-24x slower than isolated copies.

clone_topology_template helper remints .env-id and .signing-key but leaves asymmetric .opcert-key/.opcert-key.pub copied verbatim across clones, allowing multiple tests with distinct environment identity to authenticate using shared private key material, violating isolation contracts.

Session-scoped templates with per-test isolated copies (used successfully in Django, Rails, GitLab) can reduce setup time while preserving coverage and initialization/recovery contract semantics, validated by precedent peculiar-calmy-bubblefish (31% wall time reduction).

Per-test fixture copies must have disjoint ticket refs, linked-worktree paths, gate snapshots, environment IDs, signing keys, module caches, and mutable config state to maintain isolation, with sentinels to fail on stale pointers, shared refs, or non-virgin templates.
